question: Can this prove whole-system deadlock freedom after the patch or quantify latency and fleet impact?

criteria.instruction: The snapshot and callback test establish selected order/reentry hazards. The proposed regressions address those paths, not every acquisition or whole-system liveness. No representative latency series, contention denominator or fleet inventory is supplied.
Cite wait-state limits and pending repair scope, separating demonstrated cycles from broader coverage.
Decline global deadlock-freedom certification, quantified latency improvement and complete impact counts. Do not infer no impact from heartbeat success.
